captions.text: Hey Prosperity Roofing team,
I took a look because roofing leads
are one of the hardest to catch
when the phone starts ringing nonstop.
A missed call can turn into a
voicemail, then a slow callback,
and by the time you reach them,
another roofer has already booked the inspection.
What we do is simple,
our AI calls the lead back within
30 seconds, finds out what they need,
books the job straight to your calendar,
and texts your team the details.
You keep your existing number,
your website and Google setup stay the
same, and we build and train it
on Prosperity Roofing in 48 hours.
We can even reactivate your old missed-call
list in week one,
and it is $197 a month locked
for life, no setup fee for founding
operators, month to month,
and you do not pay until it
books your first job.
If it is useful,
I would love to show you how
it would work for your team.
